result:
Three places in the patient chart app call `reportError` from `@openmrs/esm-framework`. A repo-wide grep of `.ts`/`.tsx` files found no other callers. I did not check the framework's own definition of `reportError`, so I haven't confirmed which behaviours would matter.

- **`useOrderableConceptSWR`** in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/useOrderableConceptSets.ts`:
  - It imports `reportError` (lines 1–8).
  - An effect with no dependency array calls it whenever the SWR fetch has an `error` (lines 34–38). A change in `reportError` would therefore apply on every render while the error persists.
- **`useOrderableConceptSets`** in the same file:
  - An effect calls `reportError(error)` when `error` changes (lines 71–75).
  - This hook wraps the one above, so the same fetch error is reported twice.
- **`persistFavorites`** in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-favorites/useFavoritesActions.ts`:
  - It imports `reportError` (line 2).
  - It calls `reportError(error)` in the catch block when saving drug favorites fails (line 57).
  - It then shows an error snackbar, so a change that throws or shows its own UI would interact with that snackbar.
